name: European Sports Week
description: The city celebrates sports with a week of diverse events, from nighttime water aerobics to scenic races that end with a picnic.
longDescription:
European Sports Week is an annual initiative promoting physical activity and healthy lifestyles across the continent. This Porto edition, held in 2026, is part of a broader European Union campaign. The event aims to encourage participation in sports and exercise, offering a range of activities designed to appeal to various interests and fitness levels.

Attendees can engage in a variety of athletic pursuits, from aquatic fitness sessions held after dark to organized runs concluding with an outdoor meal. The events take place at different locations throughout Porto, utilizing the city's diverse settings for recreational purposes. The program is designed to be inclusive, welcoming individuals of all ages and abilities to participate in the scheduled activities.

Many of the events offered during European Sports Week are free to attend. Specific venue details and transportation information for each activity will be made available closer to the event date. The program is suitable for families and individuals seeking opportunities for physical engagement.
